subject: science
concept: Identifying independent and dependent variables in an investigation
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student changes one factor in a simple hands-on setup and observes what changes as a result
exercise.pictorial: Student labels the 'thing I changed' and 'thing I measured' in a pictured setup
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the independent and dependent variable in a described investigation

misconception_flags: confuses which variable is being changed (independent) versus measured (dependent)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
